name: batch-17
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A small rust-red carved wooden horse facing right, with upright ears, four sturdy legs and an ivory rectangular saddle patch bearing a simple muted-teal V-shaped mark; preserve the original painted wooden silhouette.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A rounded sage-green ceramic teapot with a short left spout, right loop handle, pale lid and simple light-green leaf mark, accompanied by one small ivory tea cup at lower right.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A warm reddish-brown wooden spinning top with a rounded wide shoulder, sharp lower tip, short upright spindle and two ivory bands; an ivory cotton pull cord wraps around it and ends in one small wooden bead.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A dusty-red textile cord forming one closed loop around a simple tan wooden display support, with a small pale-gold rectangular clasp near the bottom; no heart charm, deity figure or added script.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: An open small journal with a muted sage-green cover, cream curved pages, simple green mountain-and-path lines and a dusty-coral ribbon bookmark hanging near the right page; no map labels, stamps or religious signs.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A low oval ring of gray-green stone around bright blue water, with one small smooth golden token hovering above its center and a pale circular ripple below; no coin engraving, sacred symbols or extra offerings.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A small silver-gray metal pitcher tilted to pour one thin blue stream into a wide warm brass-colored basin, with turquoise water and one small pink floating petal; no deity image or ceremonial lettering.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A small glowing amber paper lantern with a rounded ribbed cylindrical body, dark-brown top and bottom rims, short red suspension cord and one little tan rectangular wish plaque hanging below; no readable writing or invented symbols.
Cells 9 through 9: completely empty transparent; do not draw any object in these cells.
